evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 1998 S52 M Roadster with a manual gearbox and a fitted silver hardtop, in black leather. Photos show clean paint, wheels and dash. Observed issues are a lit CHECK ENGINE lamp in the cluster photo (unknown whether the engine was running), driver-bolster wear, and a small mileage discrepancy (69,351 on the odometer photo versus 69,532 in the text). There is no VIN, no records and no history report, and the clean title and no-damage statements are seller checkboxes only. Both model-critical items that apply are missing: no rear-structure or diff-mount evidence on a Midwest, Illinois-plated car, and no cooling history; the S54 rod-bearing item does not apply. The $19,950 ask sits about 7% above the fair-value midpoint of $18,585, and the car has been listed unchanged for 28+ weeks. The seller's cash-only, terse posture leaves PPI access an open question.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, a title photo, a running-engine cluster photo with scan codes, and trunk-floor and underside photos, and ask directly whether a PPI at a Milwaukee BMW independent will be allowed before any payment.
